title: Redo resurrects state that the user overwrote
prompt: Users of the editor: undo, type something new, press redo — the panel jumps back to the discarded pre-edit state. The rule is the classic one: committing a new value clears the redo branch, because after an edit there is nothing to redo. Fix lib/history.mjs and verify with your own script (commit/undo/commit/redo, walking to both ends, no-op undo/redo) before answering.
